name: Stripe Checkout (hosted checkout.stripe.com)
notes: Same fill surface as Payment Links; pattern proven in the 2026-06 campaign.

steps.addToCart: A merchant-side 'Checkout'/'Buy' button redirects to the hosted page.
steps.contact: #email, plus name/address inputs directly on the page.
steps.payment: Direct inputs on Stripe's domain, no iframe: #cardNumber, #cardExpiry, then the CVV token into #cardCvc immediately after the number.
